title: File:Wyoming Sagebrush (15560437116).jpg
author: USFWS Mountain-Prairie
description:
Protecting healthy sagebrush benefits greater sage-grouse and hundreds of species of wildlife. This view from Trappers' Point near Pinedale captures the structure of a healthy plant and the wide open expanses greater sage-grouse, pronghorn and mule deer need to survive.
